decisions.reason: After two years without website presence, this close-to-core software has likely revealed limited standalone traction, and real-options logic now favors reallocating attention to newer digital offerings.
This was already a less prominent variant and its continued absence suggests the option value has largely expired, so management would more likely discontinue it than keep monitoring it.
As a niche hardware add-on outside the firm's main digital growth path, prolonged non-observation indicates weak payoff potential relative to keeping resources tied up in it.
The lightly presented mechanical niche product has had enough time for demand to become clearer, and the lack of later visibility points to abandoning this option.
Even without distinct later web visibility, control technology remains central to the firm's automation business and can still be retained as a project-based option at manageable cost.

This newer automation and system software is closely aligned with the firm's connected and data-driven direction, and with limited negative evidence management would keep the option open a bit longer.
